_comment: Hand labels against the ai-architect-mcp src/ tree, PINNED to the commit named in corpus.toml (git_rev): the corpus is that immutable tree, not the live working tree, so a label can only go stale if it was wrong (issue #397). Each label was cross-checked against the source (grep plus enclosing-function scan) and against an independent regex analyzer. Qualified names follow the `<rel_path>::<name>` convention of parser/mod.rs qual(). Label policy: q4/q7 callers are ALL callers, test functions included, including calls inside macro token trees such as assert!/assert_eq! and via `use super::*` (labels follow the source, not what the tool sees; measured on the pinned tree the tool resolves all of them, q4 = q7 = 1.000, so the policy guards against a future regression rather than excusing a gap). Re-pin procedure: see benches/README.md. Version 2 adds Q8, Q9, Q11, Q12, Q13, Q14.
